title: Identifying Seasons
ques: Which season is usually very hot, meaning you might wear a t-shirt and go swimming to cool off?

answer.content: The **Summer** season is usually very hot.

explanation: This exercise helps students identify seasons based on temperature and common activities.

title: Seasonal Clothing
ques: If it is Winter and it is snowing outside, name two things you should wear before going out to play.

answer.content: You should wear warm clothes like a **thick jacket**, a **woolen cap** (or beanie), **gloves**, and a **scarf**.

explanation: This teaches the practical application of understanding weather and dressing appropriately.

title: Changes in Nature
ques: During which season do many trees lose their leaves and the leaves turn orange, yellow, and brown?

answer.content: Trees usually lose their leaves during the **Autumn** (or Fall) season.

explanation: This encourages observation of the natural world and seasonal cycles.
